allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.15 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaflets; pinkish-white flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): five petals between five sepals, ten stamens and a pistil of five carpels, from the characters of Oxalidaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.carpels.note: How PlantGen draws a flower, a choice of the model's (spec rework P5): the flower characters set a flower card's perianth, its parts, how they differ by place, how far the corolla is joined into a tube, a floral cup, where the ovary sits, a resupinate flower's turn, its stamens, staminodes and carpels and its spurs. The rules also set these fields in a season's flower and bud looks that draw a flower, unless set there by hand.

appearance.organs.leaf.shape.note: The leaf drawn as a palmately compound leaf of three leaflets (spec rework P4), set from its characters by the rules at the flowering plants; before, one broad blade stood in for it. By eye: the leaflets spread evenly round the stalk's tip, each widest near its broad, flat-topped tip (an obcordate leaflet's notch is not drawn) and about as wide as long. The card now holds a stub of the stalk, so the leaf is drawn 6 cm long where its blade was 4.5 cm: each leaflet about 3.5 cm.

appearance.organs.leaf.shape.leaflets.note: How PlantGen draws a divided leaf, a choice of the model's (spec rework P4): the leaf characters set a compound card's pattern, its leaflets or pinnae, the leaflets on each pinna, and whether its segments run together. A pinnate leaf's count says how it ends (odd-pinnate odd, even-pinnate even), so a flora's range is drawn as the nearest count of the right kind.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a low carpet of shamrock-like leaves, three heart-shaped leaflets on each stalk, with pink-veined white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant bears both sexes, unless its taxa state it dioecious.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
